data.title: 佐天泪子 · 夏夜凉席边的风铃浅憩
data.description: 祭典归来的闷热夏夜里，两人并排仰躺在老式和室的蔺草凉席上。电风扇吱呀转动，屋檐下的玻璃风铃清脆作响。泪子的藤紫浴衣衣领微敞，露出光洁优美的锁骨。她侧过头看着近在咫尺的侧脸，悄悄伸出手指勾住了对方的衣角，嘴角浮现满足安详的微笑。
data.location: traditional tatami room with open sliding doors
data.action: 她侧过头看着近在咫尺的侧脸，悄悄伸出手指勾住了对方的衣角，嘴角浮现满足安详的微笑
data.lighting: pale moonlight and soft paper screen shadows
data.promptProse: Ruiko lies on her back on the left tatami mat in a lilac floral yukata, her long black hair spreading beneath its white flower clip. Her companion lies next to her in a slate-blue striped jinbei, with short brown hair and a narrow side profile. She turns toward him as their pinkies meet beneath the glass wind chime.
